newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW denies troubles in Chinese venture.
newsitem.headline: VW denies troubles in Chinese venture.

text.p: German carmaker Volkswagen AG said on Monday that a weekend magazine report saying its joint-venture with the Chinese carmaker First Automotive Works (FAW) faced possible closure was incorrect.
"There is no plan for us to pull out of the joint venture," a VW spokesman said.
Germany's Der Spiegel magazine reported at the weekend that VW's factory in the northeast Chinese city of Changchun has seen heavy losses and that production of VW's Jetta car had practically ceased.
Officials at the joint venture in China on Monday also dismissed the magazine report, saying production was still continuing.
